answer: The anchor edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 184 clones produces a signature the glacier analysis flags immediately. A hostile operator must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, and as a result doing work rather than printing keys, and the inlet settlement applies the void retroactively. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
